classificationSemantics.lost: former visible computation no longer called for anatomy
classificationSemantics.dormant: module still exists but no longer determines live structural output
classificationSemantics.weakened: physical operator present but constrained to narrow effects
classificationSemantics.partial: requires independent acceptance evidence beyond its existence

limitations: This inventory is source-code evidence; historical visual results and physical legitimacy require separate replay.
A procedural warp is not a material transaction. Equations described as legacy are not authoritative biological laws.
Historical 120-day morphological stages and early 240-day preview are not the 365 daily-check clock.
No species IDs, stock silhouettes, or reproductive evolution are desired.
